notes: The leashing reads in living.h were verified as a carried flag only; the leash knot and handover behaviour were not found anywhere in csrc/engine or csrc/play. lane/idxentity: the three missing items were stale (spawnExplosionParticle, canAttackClass and the name tag's state are ported; CustomNameVisible is command-only). Real gaps fixed: a mob's loot pickup saw only the mobs' own drops (now both pools), a picked-up weapon never applied its attack modifier, a thrown diamond never granted diamondsToYou, and a persistent living (picked-up loot, a name tag) still counted toward the spawn caps (ent-loot-s42 fails at the row the cap frees without it).
